title: Banor first meeting

nodes.speaker: Banor
nodes.text: Good morning, boss. I didn't think old Thaddeus would ever persuade anyone to take this place on, considering...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Good morning, boss. I didn't think old Thaddeus would ever persuade anyone to take this place on, considering...

nodes.speaker: Banor
nodes.text: Hey, you set the tables and chairs and chose a menu already! That's a good start.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey, you set the tables and chairs and chose a menu already! That's a good start.

nodes.speaker: Banor
nodes.text: We can get to work! Hey, by the way, thanks for giving me my old job back.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We can get to work! Hey, by the way, thanks for giving me my old job back.

nodes.speaker: Banor
nodes.text: I guess I come with the place? I still have a contract, even when the owner changes. Unless you want me gone?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I guess I come with the place? I still have a contract, even when the owner changes. Unless you want me gone?

nodes.speaker: Banor
nodes.text: Right boss. Well, we have a lot to do today. Your hands look soft and clean. You afraid of some hard work?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Right boss. Well, we have a lot to do today. Your hands look soft and clean. You afraid of some hard work?

nodes.speaker: Banor
nodes.text: I knew it! I got a few years left to retirement and I plan to accelerate into it. No slacking off for me!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I knew it! I got a few years left to retirement and I plan to accelerate into it. No slacking off for me!

nodes.speaker: Banor
nodes.text: You don't have to come at me like that, boss. I don't slack off.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You don't have to come at me like that, boss. I don't slack off.

nodes.speaker: Banor
nodes.text: First things first, boss, I don't need you in the kitchen. But we only got enough ingredients for two more meals. Think you could go to the market?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: First things first, boss, I don't need you in the kitchen. But we only got enough ingredients for two more meals. Think you could go to the market?

nodes.speaker: Banor
nodes.text: I'll get you a list. Should be able to get it all from the vendors in the market over there.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll get you a list. Should be able to get it all from the vendors in the market over there.

nodes.speaker: Banor
nodes.text: Oh... errm... no nothing it's fine. It's all probably fine... I should think.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh... errm... no nothing it's fine. It's all probably fine... I should think.

nodes.speaker: Banor
nodes.text: Someone's gotta work this place, boss. I only got two hands, two legs and one back.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Someone's gotta work this place, boss. I only got two hands, two legs and one back.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm the owner here. You do the hard work.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm the owner here. You do the hard work.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm the owner here. You do the hard work.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm the owner here. You do the hard work.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I already took care of that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I already took care of that.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I already took care of that.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I already took care of that.
